description.value: The study examined structural gray matter volume, cue-related brain activation, and functional connectivity in male military veterans with cocaine use and different durations of abstinence, comparing USERS, ABSTINENCE, and CONTROLS.

spans.text: This study is unique in that it examined differences (possible changes) in brain structure, activation and connectivity as a function of long-term cocaine abstinence for a duration ranging from 1 year to 30 years, among military veterans.
